featured_reviews.name: Adnan Ghadiali
featured_reviews.review_text:
I would not recommend Lee PPF based on my experience.

I was promised a 5-year warranty when I got PPF installed on my car. However, within just 2 days of installation, multiple air bubbles started appearing under the film, which is very disappointing for a supposedly premium product and service.

The bigger issue has been the after-sales support. I contacted Bhim Khushwaha multiple times by both phone and WhatsApp regarding the problem. On at least three occasions, he assured me that he would come and inspect the vehicle. He even confirmed specific dates and times, but never showed up and did not provide any proper update.

Any product can have issues, but what matters is how the company handles them. Unfortunately, the lack of responsiveness and failure to honor commitments has left me extremely disappointed.

If you are considering Lee PPF, I would suggest evaluating not only the installation quality but also the after-sales service and warranty support before making a decision.
